title: Smoky Beef Stew
description: A hearty, comforting stew with smoky flavors inspired by Japanese cuisine.

ingredients.name: Ethiopian berbere spice blend
ingredients.notes: available in most Japanese markets or online

instructions: In a large Dutch oven or heavy pot, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat.
Add beef in batches and brown until cooked, about 5 minutes. Remove beef and set aside.
Add remaining 1 tablespoon of oil, then sauté stew seasoning, berbere spice blend, and flour for 1 minute.
Gradually stir in water, scraping the pot to release browned bits.
Return beef to the pot, cover, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 1 hour.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with sliced almonds (optional).
